title: Initial financial planning meeting notes
content:
Attendees: Jamie Krag and Aimee Smith-Krag.

Jamie is a software engineer with a $230,000 base salary, a 15% target bonus and recurring restricted stock awards. Aimee is a hospital pharmacist with a $135,000 base salary and additional weekend shifts. They married recently and use joint checking for shared bills, but most accounts are still separate.

Priorities: understand what they can afford in San Mateo County, combine finances, and see whether retirement at 55 is feasible. They rent in San Mateo and expect this to be their first year filing taxes as a married couple. Follow up on employer benefits, outside retirement accounts and the employer equity schedule.

title: Household net worth snapshot — January 2025
content:
Prepared for Jamie Krag and Aimee Smith-Krag. Values as of January 19, 2025.

Cash accounts: Jamie $10,000; Aimee $10,000; joint checking $25,000. Jamie's taxable brokerage: $366,255. Retirement: Jamie's traditional 401(k) $93,900; Aimee's current Roth 403(b) $85,860; former-employer traditional 403(b) $34,960; TIAA annuity $10,000. Vehicles: Tesla Model S $35,000; Subaru Forester $33,000. Total assets: $703,975.

Student loans: Jamie $287,000 and Aimee $180,000. Total liabilities: $467,000. Household net worth: $236,975.

title: 2025 projected household cash flow
content:
Prepared from the household's income and spending estimates.

Projected income: Jamie salary $230,000 and bonus $34,500; Aimee salary $135,000 and weekend shifts $22,750. Total projected income $422,250. Projected expenses $346,000, including $48,000 rent, $12,000 utilities, $65,000 student loan payments and $135,000 taxes. Annual retirement savings budget: Jamie $18,400; Aimee $13,500. Projected cash surplus: $44,350.

These are planning estimates, not payroll, tax or account statements.
